# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

## Data Source

### lcoe_trends
Annual LCOE values for three technologies: `solar_pv`, `onshore_wind`, and `battery_storage`. All values in 2023 real USD per MWh. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV ranges from 359 to 33; onshore wind from 95 to 35; battery storage from 1,100 to 102.

### fossil_fuel_lcoe_range
Biennial LCOE ranges for new-build gas CCGT (`gas_ccgt_low`, `gas_ccgt_high`) and coal (`coal_low`, `coal_high`). 8 rows at even-year intervals. Values in 2023 real USD/MWh. These define the reference band against which renewable crossover points are identified.

### installed_capacity
Cumulative global installed capacity in GW for `solar_pv_gw` and `onshore_wind_gw`. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV grows from 40 to 1,950 GW; onshore wind from 178 to 960 GW.

### fossil_fuel_subsidies
Annual global fossil fuel subsidies in nominal billion USD, split into `consumption_subsidies_bn` and `production_subsidies_bn`, with a `total_subsidies_bn` sum. 15 rows (2010–2024). Total ranges from ~290 to ~700 billion.

## Data Notes

# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

## Data Source

### lcoe_trends
Annual LCOE values for three technologies: `solar_pv`, `onshore_wind`, and `battery_storage`. All values in 2023 real USD per MWh. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV ranges from 359 to 33; onshore wind from 95 to 35; battery storage from 1,100 to 102.

### fossil_fuel_lcoe_range
Biennial LCOE ranges for new-build gas CCGT (`gas_ccgt_low`, `gas_ccgt_high`) and coal (`coal_low`, `coal_high`). 8 rows at even-year intervals. Values in 2023 real USD/MWh. These define the reference band against which renewable crossover points are identified.

### installed_capacity
Cumulative global installed capacity in GW for `solar_pv_gw` and `onshore_wind_gw`. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV grows from 40 to 1,950 GW; onshore wind from 178 to 960 GW.

### fossil_fuel_subsidies
Annual global fossil fuel subsidies in nominal billion USD, split into `consumption_subsidies_bn` and `production_subsidies_bn`, with a `total_subsidies_bn` sum. 15 rows (2010–2024). Total ranges from ~290 to ~700 billion.

## Data Notes
- LCOE figures are illustrative estimates aligned with IRENA and BloombergNEF reporting trends but rounded for clarity.
- Battery storage LCOE reflects 4-hour lithium-ion systems.
- 2022 spike in fossil LCOE and subsidies reflects the global energy price crisis.
- Fossil fuel subsidy estimates cover direct government subsidies only; implicit subsidies (e.g., unpriced externalities) are excluded.
- 2024 values are preliminary estimates.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

# ── Color Palette (editorial, publication-ready) ──
SOLAR_COLOR = '#D97706'       # amber
WIND_COLOR = '#0F766E'        # teal
BATTERY_COLOR = '#7C3AED'     # violet
FOSSIL_BAND_COLOR = '#9CA3AF' # gray
GAS_COLOR = '#DC6843'         # burnt orange
COAL_COLOR = '#6B7280'        # slate
SUBSIDY_CONS_COLOR = '#DC6843'
SUBSIDY_PROD_COLOR = '#F59E0B'
CAPACITY_SOLAR_COLOR = '#D97706'
CAPACITY_WIND_COLOR = '#0F766E'
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAFA'
GRID_COLOR = '#E5E7EB'
TEXT_COLOR = '#1F2937'
ANNOTATION_COLOR = '#B91C1C'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial'],
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#D1D5DB',
    'figure.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'axes.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'savefig.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
})

# ── Data ──
years = list(range(2010, 2025))

solar_pv = [359, 304, 223, 175, 136, 107, 86, 72, 60, 50, 42, 39, 45, 37, 33]
onshore_wind = [95, 89, 82, 78, 72, 64, 56, 52, 48, 44, 41, 38, 42, 37, 35]
battery_storage = [1100, 980, 860, 750, 620, 510, 395, 310, 245, 187, 150, 132, 139, 119, 102]

# Fossil fuel LCOE (biennial - interpolate for odd years)
fossil_years_raw = [2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024]
gas_low_raw = [55, 50, 48, 42, 44, 45, 55, 50]
gas_high_raw = [82, 78, 75, 72, 78, 74, 95, 80]
coal_low_raw = [65, 63, 60, 60, 62, 65, 75, 70]
coal_high_raw = [105, 100, 98, 95, 100, 110, 130, 120]

gas_low_interp = np.interp(years, fossil_years_raw, gas_low_raw)
gas_high_interp = np.interp(years, fossil_years_raw, gas_high_raw)
coal_low_interp = np.interp(years, fossil_years_raw, coal_low_raw)
coal_high_interp = np.interp(years, fossil_years_raw, coal_high_raw)

# Installed capacity
solar_gw = [40, 70, 100, 137, 177, 227, 303, 402, 512, 627, 760, 942, 1185, 1550, 1950]
wind_gw = [178, 215, 260, 296, 336, 380, 425, 480, 540, 594, 650, 725, 800, 880, 960]

# Fossil fuel subsidies
subsidy_total = [410, 500, 530, 510, 490, 325, 310, 340, 400, 380, 290, 440, 700, 620, 550]
subsidy_cons = [350, 430, 455, 435, 415, 260, 250, 275, 330, 310, 230, 365, 610, 530, 465]
subsidy_prod = [60, 70, 75, 75, 75, 65, 60, 65, 70, 70, 60, 75, 90, 90, 85]

# ── Crossover calculation ──
# Find year when solar PV drops below coal high (enters fossil range)
solar_coal_high_crossover = None
wind_coal_low_crossover = None
solar_gas_low_crossover = None
wind_gas_low_crossover = None

for i, y in enumerate(years):
    if solar_coal_high_crossover is None and solar_pv[i] < coal_high_interp[i]:
        solar_coal_high_crossover = y
    if wind_coal_low_crossover is None and onshore_wind[i] < coal_low_interp[i]:
        wind_coal_low_crossover = y
    if solar_gas_low_crossover is None and solar_pv[i] < gas_low_interp[i]:
        solar_gas_low_crossover = y
    if wind_gas_low_crossover is None and onshore_wind[i] < gas_low_interp[i]:
        wind_gas_low_crossover = y

# ── Figure Layout ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14))
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.4, 1], hspace=0.30, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.07, right=0.96, top=0.92, bottom=0.06)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: LCOE Trends (top, full width)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])

# Fossil fuel cost band (combined range: gas low to coal high)
ax1.fill_between(years, gas_low_interp, coal_high_interp,
                 alpha=0.15, color=FOSSIL_BAND_COLOR, zorder=1,
                 label='Fossil fuel LCOE range (gas–coal)')

# Inner band (gas range)
ax1.fill_between(years, gas_low_interp, gas_high_interp,
                 alpha=0.12, color='#6B7280', zorder=1)

# LCOE lines
ax1.plot(years, battery_storage, color=BATTERY_COLOR, linewidth=2.8, marker='o',
         markersize=5, label='Battery storage', zorder=4, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=BATTERY_COLOR)
ax1.plot(years, solar_pv, color=SOLAR_COLOR, linewidth=2.8, marker='s',
         markersize=5, label='Solar PV', zorder=5, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=SOLAR_COLOR)
ax1.plot(years, onshore_wind, color=WIND_COLOR, linewidth=2.8, marker='^',
         markersize=5, label='Onshore wind', zorder=5, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=WIND_COLOR)

# Fossil reference lines (dashed)
ax1.plot(years, gas_low_interp, color=GAS_COLOR, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--',
         alpha=0.6, label='Gas CCGT low', zorder=2)
ax1.plot(years, coal_high_interp, color=COAL_COLOR, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--',
         alpha=0.6, label='Coal high', zorder=2)

# ── Crossover annotations ──
def annotate_crossover(ax, year, lcoe_val, text, y_offset=0, side='right'):
    x_idx = years.index(year)
    ax.plot(year, lcoe_val, 'o', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR, markersize=10,
            zorder=10, markerfacecolor='none', markeredgewidth=2.5)
    if side == 'right':
        ax.annotate(text, xy=(year, lcoe_val),
                    xytext=(year + 1.2, lcoe_val + y_offset),
                    fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR, lw=1.3),
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2',
                              edgecolor=ANNOTATION_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
                    zorder=11)
    else:
        ax.annotate(text, xy=(year, lcoe_val),
                    xytext=(year - 1.2, lcoe_val + y_offset),
                    fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR, lw=1.3),
                    ha='right',
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2',
                              edgecolor=ANNOTATION_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
                    zorder=11)

# Solar enters fossil range (crosses below coal high)
if solar_coal_high_crossover:
    idx = years.index(solar_coal_high_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, solar_coal_high_crossover, solar_pv[idx],
                       f'Solar enters\nfossil range\n({solar_coal_high_crossover})',
                       y_offset=20, side='left')

# Wind drops below coal low
if wind_coal_low_crossover:
    idx = years.index(wind_coal_low_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, wind_coal_low_crossover, onshore_wind[idx],
                       f'Wind below\ncoal cost\n({wind_coal_low_crossover})',
                       y_offset=-25, side='right')

# Solar below gas low
if solar_gas_low_crossover:
    idx = years.index(solar_gas_low_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, solar_gas_low_crossover, solar_pv[idx],
                       f'Solar below\ngas cost\n({solar_gas_low_crossover})',
                       y_offset=15, side='right')

# Wind below gas low
if wind_gas_low_crossover:
    idx = years.index(wind_gas_low_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, wind_gas_low_crossover, onshore_wind[idx],
                       f'Wind below\ngas cost\n({wind_gas_low_crossover})',
                       y_offset=-25, side='left')

# Battery cost collapse annotation
ax1.annotate('Battery storage: −91%\n$1,100 → $102/MWh',
             xy=(2010, 1100), xytext=(2012.5, 800),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=BATTERY_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=BATTERY_COLOR, lw=1.5),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#F5F3FF',
                       edgecolor=BATTERY_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
             zorder=11)

# Solar decline annotation
ax1.annotate('Solar PV: −91%\n$359 → $33/MWh',
             xy=(2010, 359), xytext=(2011.5, 500),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=SOLAR_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=SOLAR_COLOR, lw=1.5),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFFBEB',
                       edgecolor=SOLAR_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
             zorder=11)

ax1.set_yscale('log')
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(
    lambda x, _: f'${int(x)}' if x >= 1 else f'${x:.1f}'))
ax1.set_ylabel('Levelized Cost of Energy (USD/MWh, 2023 real)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('')
ax1.set_xlim(2009.5, 2024.8)
ax1.set_ylim(25, 1400)
ax1.set_xticks(years)
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, which='major', axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7)
ax1.grid(True, which='minor', axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.5)
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
           ncol=2, borderpad=0.8)

# Panel title
ax1.set_title('Renewable Energy LCOE Collapse vs. Fossil Fuel Cost Range (2010–2024)',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Installed Capacity (bottom-left)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

ax2.fill_between(years, 0, solar_gw, alpha=0.25, color=CAPACITY_SOLAR_COLOR, zorder=2)
ax2.fill_between(years, 0, wind_gw, alpha=0.25, color=CAPACITY_WIND_COLOR, zorder=1)

         markeredgewidth=1.3, markeredgecolor=CAPACITY_SOLAR_COLOR)
ax2.plot(years, wind_gw, color=CAPACITY_WIND_COLOR, linewidth=2.5, marker='^',
         markersize=4, label='Onshore wind', zorder=3, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.3, markeredgecolor=CAPACITY_WIND_COLOR)

ax2.annotate('Solar PV accelerates\npost-2018: 49× growth\nsince 2010',

ax2.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 2200)

ax2.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D1D5DB')

              fontsize=11.5, fontweight='bold', pad=10, color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Fossil Fuel Subsidies (bottom-right)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

bar_width = 0.7
bars_cons = ax3.bar(years, subsidy_cons, bar_width, color=SUBSIDY_CONS_COLOR,
                    alpha=0.85, label='Consumption subsidies', zorder=3)

             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#7F1D1D',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#7F1D1D', lw=1.3),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2',

# Add average line
avg_subsidy = np.mean(subsidy_total)
ax3.axhline(y=avg_subsidy, color='#6B7280', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7)
ax3.text(2024.5, avg_subsidy + 10, f'Avg: ${avg_subsidy:.0f}B',

# Contrast annotation
ax3.text(0.97, 0.65,

         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#FEF2F2',

ax3.set_ylabel('Annual Subsidies (Billion USD, nominal)', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('')
ax3.set_xlim(2009.2, 2025.3)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 800)
ax3.set_xticks(years)
ax3.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=8, rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7)
ax3.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D1D5DB')

ax3.set_title('Global Fossil Fuel Subsidies Persist Despite Renewable Cost Decline',
              fontsize=11.5, fontweight='bold', pad=10, color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ── Main Title ──
fig.suptitle('The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: 2010–2024',
             fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color=TEXT_COLOR)
fig.text(0.5, 0.945,
         'LCOE declines of 63–91% for renewables vs. persistent $290–700B annual fossil fuel subsidies',
         ha='center', fontsize=10.5, color='#6B7280', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Save ──
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved successfully.")

subsidy_total = [410, 500, 530, 510, 490, 325, 310, 340, 400, 380, 290, 440, 700, 620, 550]
subsidy_cons = [350, 430, 455, 435, 415, 260, 250, 275, 330, 310, 230, 365, 610, 530, 465]
subsidy_prod = [60, 70, 75, 75, 75, 65, 60, 65, 70, 70, 60, 75, 90, 90, 85]

# ── Crossover calculation ──
# Find year when solar PV drops below coal high (enters fossil range)
solar_coal_high_crossover = None
wind_coal_low_crossover = None
solar_gas_low_crossover = None
wind_gas_low_crossover = None

for i, y in enumerate(years):
    if solar_coal_high_crossover is None and solar_pv[i] < coal_high_interp[i]:
        solar_coal_high_crossover = y
    if wind_coal_low_crossover is None and onshore_wind[i] < coal_low_interp[i]:
        wind_coal_low_crossover = y
    if solar_gas_low_crossover is None and solar_pv[i] < gas_low_interp[i]:
        solar_gas_low_crossover = y
    if wind_gas_low_crossover is None and onshore_wind[i] < gas_low_interp[i]:
        wind_gas_low_crossover = y

# ── Figure Layout ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14))
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.4, 1], hspace=0.30, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.07, right=0.96, top=0.92, bottom=0.06)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: LCOE Trends (top, full width)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])

# Fossil fuel cost band (combined range: gas low to coal high)
ax1.fill_between(years, gas_low_interp, coal_high_interp,
                 alpha=0.15, color=FOSSIL_BAND_COLOR, zorder=1,
                 label='Fossil fuel LCOE range (gas–coal)')

# Inner band (gas range)
ax1.fill_between(years, gas_low_interp, gas_high_interp,
                 alpha=0.12, color='#6B7280', zorder=1)

# LCOE lines
ax1.plot(years, battery_storage, color=BATTERY_COLOR, linewidth=2.8, marker='o',
         markersize=5, label='Battery storage', zorder=4, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=BATTERY_COLOR)
ax1.plot(years, solar_pv, color=SOLAR_COLOR, linewidth=2.8, marker='s',
         markersize=5, label='Solar PV', zorder=5, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=SOLAR_COLOR)
ax1.plot(years, onshore_wind, color=WIND_COLOR, linewidth=2.8, marker='^',
         markersize=5, label='Onshore wind', zorder=5, markerfacecolor='white',
         markeredgewidth=1.5, markeredgecolor=WIND_COLOR)

# Fossil reference lines (dashed)
ax1.plot(years, gas_low_interp, color=GAS_COLOR, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--',
         alpha=0.6, label='Gas CCGT low', zorder=2)
ax1.plot(years, coal_high_interp, color=COAL_COLOR, linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--',
         alpha=0.6, label='Coal high', zorder=2)

# ── Crossover annotations ──
def annotate_crossover(ax, year, lcoe_val, text, y_offset=0, side='right'):
    x_idx = years.index(year)
    ax.plot(year, lcoe_val, 'o', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR, markersize=10,
            zorder=10, markerfacecolor='none', markeredgewidth=2.5)
    if side == 'right':
        ax.annotate(text, xy=(year, lcoe_val),
                    xytext=(year + 1.2, lcoe_val + y_offset),
                    fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR, lw=1.3),
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2',
                              edgecolor=ANNOTATION_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
                    zorder=11)
    else:
        ax.annotate(text, xy=(year, lcoe_val),
                    xytext=(year - 1.2, lcoe_val + y_offset),
                    fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOTATION_COLOR, lw=1.3),
                    ha='right',
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2',
                              edgecolor=ANNOTATION_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
                    zorder=11)

# Solar enters fossil range (crosses below coal high)
if solar_coal_high_crossover:
    idx = years.index(solar_coal_high_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, solar_coal_high_crossover, solar_pv[idx],
                       f'Solar enters\nfossil range\n({solar_coal_high_crossover})',
                       y_offset=20, side='left')

# Wind drops below coal low
if wind_coal_low_crossover:
    idx = years.index(wind_coal_low_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, wind_coal_low_crossover, onshore_wind[idx],
                       f'Wind below\ncoal cost\n({wind_coal_low_crossover})',
                       y_offset=-25, side='right')

# Solar below gas low
if solar_gas_low_crossover:
    idx = years.index(solar_gas_low_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, solar_gas_low_crossover, solar_pv[idx],
                       f'Solar below\ngas cost\n({solar_gas_low_crossover})',
                       y_offset=15, side='right')

# Wind below gas low
if wind_gas_low_crossover:
    idx = years.index(wind_gas_low_crossover)
    annotate_crossover(ax1, wind_gas_low_crossover, onshore_wind[idx],
                       f'Wind below\ngas cost\n({wind_gas_low_crossover})',
                       y_offset=-25, side='left')

# Battery cost collapse annotation
ax1.annotate('Battery storage: −91%\n$1,100 → $102/MWh',
             xy=(2010, 1100), xytext=(2012.5, 800),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=BATTERY_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=BATTERY_COLOR, lw=1.5),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#F5F3FF',
                       edgecolor=BATTERY_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
             zorder=11)

# Solar decline annotation
ax1.annotate('Solar PV: −91%\n$359 → $33/MWh',
             xy=(2010, 359), xytext=(2011.5, 500),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=SOLAR_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=SOLAR_COLOR, lw=1.5),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFFBEB',
                       edgecolor=SOLAR_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
             zorder=11)

ax1.set_yscale('log')
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(
    lambda x, _: f'${int(x)}' if x >= 1 else f'${x:.1f}'))
ax1.set_ylabel('Levelized Cost of Energy (USD/MWh, 2023 real)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('')
ax1.set_xlim(2009.5, 2024.8)
ax1.set_ylim(25, 1400)
ax1.set_xticks(years)
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, which='major', axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7)
ax1.grid(True, which='minor', axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.5)
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D1D5DB',
           ncol=2, borderpad=0.8)

# Panel title
ax1.set_title('Renewable Energy LCOE Collapse vs. Fossil Fuel Cost Range (2010–2024)',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Installed Capacity (bottom-left)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

ax2.fill_between(years, 0, solar_gw, alpha=0.25, color=CAPACITY_SOLAR_COLOR, zorder=2)
ax2.fill_between(years, 0, wind_gw, alpha=0.25, color=CAPACITY_WIND_COLOR, zorder=1)

             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFFBEB',
                       edgecolor=CAPACITY_SOLAR_COLOR, alpha=0.9),
             zorder=5)

# End values
ax2.annotate(f'{solar_gw[-1]:,} GW', xy=(2024, solar_gw[-1]),
             xytext=(2024.3, solar_gw[-1]),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=CAPACITY_SOLAR_COLOR, va='center')
ax2.annotate(f'{wind_gw[-1]:,} GW', xy=(2024, wind_gw[-1]),
             xytext=(2024.3, wind_gw[-1]),
             fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=CAPACITY_WIND_COLOR, va='center')

ax2.set_ylabel('Cumulative Installed Capacity (GW)', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('')
ax2.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 2200)
ax2.set_xticks(years)
ax2.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=8, rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7)
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D1D5DB')

ax2.set_title('Cumulative Global Installed Capacity',
              fontsize=11.5, fontweight='bold', pad=10, color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Fossil Fuel Subsidies (bottom-right)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

bar_width = 0.7
bars_cons = ax3.bar(years, subsidy_cons, bar_width, color=SUBSIDY_CONS_COLOR,
                    alpha=0.85, label='Consumption subsidies', zorder=3)
bars_prod = ax3.bar(years, subsidy_prod, bar_width, bottom=subsidy_cons,
                    color=SUBSIDY_PROD_COLOR, alpha=0.85,
                    label='Production subsidies', zorder=3)

# Add total line on top
ax3.plot(years, subsidy_total, color='#1F2937', linewidth=2, marker='o',
         markersize=3.5, zorder=5, label='Total subsidies', markerfacecolor='#1F2937')

# Annotate 2022 spike
ax3.annotate('2022 energy crisis\n$700B peak',
             xy=(2022, 700), xytext=(2019.5, 730),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#7F1D1D',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#7F1D1D', lw=1.3),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2',
                       edgecolor='#7F1D1D', alpha=0.9),
             zorder=6)

# Add average line
avg_subsidy = np.mean(subsidy_total)
ax3.axhline(y=avg_subsidy, color='#6B7280', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7)
ax3.text(2024.5, avg_subsidy + 10, f'Avg: ${avg_subsidy:.0f}B',
         fontsize=8, color='#6B7280', fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# Contrast annotation
ax3.text(0.97, 0.65,
         'Meanwhile, annual fossil subsidies\nremain 5–17× the LCOE of\nnew solar & wind generation',
         transform=ax3.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, fontstyle='italic',
         color='#7F1D1D', ha='right', va='top',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#FEF2F2',
                   edgecolor='#D1D5DB', alpha=0.9))

ax3.set_ylabel('Annual Subsidies (Billion USD, nominal)', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('')
ax3.set_xlim(2009.2, 2025.3)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 800)
ax3.set_xticks(years)
ax3.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=8, rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, axis='y', color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7)
ax3.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#D1D5DB')

ax3.set_title('Global Fossil Fuel Subsidies Persist Despite Renewable Cost Decline',
              fontsize=11.5, fontweight='bold', pad=10, color=TEXT_COLOR)

# ── Main Title ──
fig.suptitle('The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: 2010–2024',
             fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color=TEXT_COLOR)
fig.text(0.5, 0.945,
         'LCOE declines of 63–91% for renewables vs. persistent $290–700B annual fossil fuel subsidies',
         ha='center', fontsize=10.5, color='#6B7280', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Save ──
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved successfully.")
